metadataRaw.title: 30 SECOND FIX: Instant Hip Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a collection of proven exercises that target the main muscles responsible for hip pain—designed to deliver fast relief, even in as little as 30 seconds.

Each exercise works differently, targeting specific muscles from various positions. For the best results, try them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and feel hip melt away in seconds!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:38 Butterfly/Corkscrew Combo
2:34 Seated Hip Press
4:51 Step-Back
6:26 Strengthening Exercise 1
8:21 Strengthening Exercise 2
